about: Every source consulted for the Original Mileage system, reshaped from research/source-register.json (the single combined register this project already keeps) into the field names and evidence-classification vocabulary of OBD360_SERVICE_MILEAGE_RESEARCH_BRIEF_2026-10-21.md section 7. No source, URL, evidence level or limitation was changed or added by this reshaping; research/source-register.json remains the one place a source's full original record (and its licence check) lives.

evidenceClassificationMapping.note: This project's own evidence scale (E0-E5, defined in research/README.md) is kept as "tier"; this column maps it to the brief's vocabulary. The mapping is approximate at the edges (E3 covers both GUIDED_VERIFIED and some CORROBORATED cases depending on independence of corroboration; read exactClaimSupported before trusting the mapped label alone).
evidenceClassificationMapping.E1: COMMUNITY_LEAD (closed tool or forum claim, no protocol detail public)
evidenceClassificationMapping.E2: RESEARCH_ONLY (a public definition says where a value is; not reviewed against a vehicle)
evidenceClassificationMapping.E3: GUIDED_VERIFIED (the maker's own document names the exact procedure or tool function for an exact vehicle)
evidenceClassificationMapping.E4: CORROBORATED (a reply was recorded for that model year, by OBDb's own tests or a capture of that exact vehicle)
evidenceClassificationMapping.E5: OEM_VERIFIED (verified on that exact vehicle by this project, with hashed evidence) — reached by no source in this ledger
evidenceClassificationMapping.PARTIAL_YEAR_SUPPORT: Not a per-source property in this ledger; it is a per-signal, per-model-year property. See Resources/Raw/obdb_year_evidence.json and research/obdb-evidence-report.md.
evidenceClassificationMapping.QUARANTINED: Not a source property; a catalog-entry property. See the BMW/MINI/Toyota 22 DFE7 entry in Services/OemDiagnostics/KnownMislabelledDefinitions.cs and the Volt oem_operations.json candidate.

sources.title: OBDb vehicle signal sets (GitHub organisation OBDb, one repository per vehicle)
sources.accessDate: 2026-10-18 (default signal sets); 2026-10-19 (all 860 downloaded vehicle repositories, including tests and year-range files; the shipped catalog)
sources.exactClaimSupported: The default signal set of every vehicle repository, and the OBDb rows of the catalog the app ships (source id 5, revision 3fd5afe5ecf68a6d6b06beb7b4e86f23ee6df69b of 2026-10-17; the catalog's meta table records a different revision, bc13d91a..., 2026-10-03).
sources.howUsed: Counted, never copied: the coverage tables in this folder are derived from it. The app already bundles it with attribution (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
knownLimitationsAndContradictions: All commands are read services (22, 21, 01); there is no write, routine or security-access command.
About 60% of the rows in the shipped catalog are flagged debug, and 61,598 more carry a dbgfilter (debug in some model years) that the catalog dropped.
The catalog has no model-year filter; OBDb has one per command (filter) and, in four repositories, year-range signal sets.
A definition is community work. Its being listed does not mean a car answers it; a recorded reply (obdb-tests) is the evidence that one did.

licensingAndProvenanceNotes.licenceChecked: 2026-10-19 through the GitHub API: all 880 vehicle repositories report CC-BY-SA-4.0. The organisation README says the text is mostly CC BY-SA 4.0. Infrastructure repositories differ (vscode-obdb is Apache-2.0; the website and editor repositories have none) and were not used.

sources.title: commaai/opendbc (CAN message definitions)
sources.accessDate: 2026-10-17 (upstream clone, commit 48c7f06c6f27c41e7169242acb03ef9775658deb); 2026-10-19 (the copy inside the shipped catalog)
sources.exactClaimSupported: The odometer-named signals of the DBC files (upstream and as imported), and for this round the Ford oil messages in ford_lincoln_base_pt.dbc and ford_cgea1_2_ptcan_2011.dbc: Cluster_Info1_FD1 0x430 (EngOilLife_B_RqReset, bit 43), EngineData_7 0x179 / Engine_Data_7_CG1 0x159 (EngOilLife_Pc_Actl, 7 bits), EngineData_17 0x17D (EngOilLife_T_Actl, DistToNextOilChange, EngOilSrvcMsgTxt_D_Rq); a search of every DBC for oil, service and maintenance found no GM or BMW oil-life or reset signal.
sources.howUsed: Already used by the app (BroadcastOdometerProvider). The Ford messages are recorded as the mechanism of the dashboard reset and as a way to recognise a reset in a recording; nothing is sent or decoded by the app.
knownLimitationsAndContradictions: The catalog records no revision for its opendbc snapshot ('user-provided snapshot').
Several odometer signals give no unit or scale.

sources.title: Wikipedia, OBD-II PIDs
sources.exactClaimSupported: Rows for PIDs 21, 31, 4D, 4E, 5B, 5C and A6 (4E: name only), and the whole page for any PID about oil life, service or maintenance: only 5C, engine oil temperature, mentions oil.
sources.howUsed: Confirms the standard odometer PID (A6: four bytes, divided by 10, km) and that no standard PID exists for oil life or a service interval. Facts only; no text is copied.
knownLimitationsAndContradictions: A public summary of SAE J1979; the standard (paid) was not read.

sources.title: emdzej/ediabasx-docs-sgbd (cited by the project's own candidate family.bmw-mini.cbs-reset)
sources.publisher: documentation of BMW diagnostic description files
sources.accessDate: 2026-10-19 (the job index and the CBS_RESET job of the d72n47a0 page; 300,000 of 618,000 characters)
sources.exactClaimSupported: Job index and the CBS_RESET job: UDS 2E; arguments CBS_KENNUNG (item: Oel, Br_v, Br_h, NOx_a, Brfl, Sic, Sic_v, TUV, AU, Ueb, Efk), availability percentage, number of services, target month and year, remaining distance with unit, forecast distance and time intervals; CBS_RESET_DATEN_LESEN reads DID 0x4050; STEUERN_CBS_DATEN_SICHERN is routine F0ED (31 01), its status 31 03 F0ED; STATUS_CBSMOTOROELHIST 22 404F; STATUS_CODIERUNG_OEL 22 3701. The identifier that CBS_RESET writes is not shown.
sources.howUsed: Read for research only; nothing is used. The page derives from BMW's proprietary description file and carries no licence.
knownLimitationsAndContradictions: No licence. The content derives from BMW's proprietary description files.

sources.title: eeNews Europe, 'Diagnostic tester detects mileage manipulation' (26 January 2021)
sources.exactClaimSupported: The article: a Bosch tester function lists the mileage stored in various control units (the seat memory and the electronic parking assistant are named) and compares it with the speedometer reading.
sources.howUsed: Shows that several modules store mileage and that comparison is done by commercial tools. No protocol; no module list beyond the two named.
knownLimitationsAndContradictions: A mismatch is presented by the article as a sign of possible manipulation; this app reports it as an observation with the other explanations.

sources.title: OBDb recorded test replies (tests/test_cases/<model year>/commands/*.yaml and command_support.yaml in every vehicle repository)
sources.tier: E4 (a reply recorded for that model year; recorded by contributors, not by OBD360)
sources.exactClaimSupported: All 860 downloaded repositories parsed by research/tools/evidence-obdb.js: per signal and model year, whether the command applies (filter), is still debug (dbg, dbgfilter), is listed as supported (command_support.yaml) and has recorded replies with the values OBDb expects them to decode to.
sources.howUsed: Derived tables only: research/obdb-evidence-*.json and .md, research/oil-life-capability-matrix.*, and the compact Resources/Raw/obdb_year_evidence.json the app reads. The raw repositories are not in this repository.
knownLimitationsAndContradictions: The model year is the folder name; OBDb does not say how it was determined.
Replies of different commands may come from different cars.
A missing reply does not make a definition wrong.

sources.title: GM Service Bulletin 18-NA-125 (May 2024), PIP5282A (September 2016) and PIP6076 (June 2025)
sources.exactClaimSupported: The oil life monitor calculates the percentage from engine revolutions, mileage since the reset (capped at 7,500 miles from model year 2013, Volt excepted) and time (one year; two for the Volt); it starts after the first 50 miles and restarts at each reset. PIP6076: the Corvette transmission fluid life has its own reset, and after it the percentage may drop quickly (under investigation).
sources.howUsed: What a post-reset read-back should show and why the value then falls; that transmission oil life is a separate reset item.
